entries.en: I love those shows. Sure, the guy says some crazy things, but he's got a head on his shoulders. Plus he's a decent judge of people.
entries.ro: Îmi plac emisiunile alea. Sigur, tipu' zice chestii nebunești, dar are cap pe umeri. Și pe deasupra se pricepe la oameni.

entries.en: Only thing I don't quite get is – how's he figure he's safe to say all that?
entries.ro: Doar un lucru nu-mi intră în cap – cum crede că e în siguranță să zică toate alea?

entries.en: Is he out in the middle of the desert? Or maybe he's got some connections, the corps wouldn't dare touch him?
entries.ro: E pe undeva prin deșert? Sau poate are pile, corporațiile n-ar îndrăzni să-l atingă?

entries.en: Oh, he's got "friends" everywhere. Here, in Biotechnica...
entries.ro: Oh, are „prieteni” peste tot. Aici, în Biotechnica...

entries.en: Sometimes hear him talk about some great netrunner.
entries.ro: Uneori îl aud vorbind despre un netrunner grozav.

entries.en: Shoot, if I had all those connections, I wouldn't be wasting my breath on some indie radio.
entries.ro: La naiba, dacă aș avea toate relațiile alea, nu mi-aș pierde vremea la un radio indie.

entries.en: Oh? And what would you be doing?
